options.name: disable_windows_update
options.description: If V(true), prevents DISM from contacting Windows Update for the source files.

options.name: log_level
options.description: Sets the maximum output level for DISM logging. V(0) logs errors only V(1) logs errors and warnings V(2) logs errors, warnings, and information V(3) logs all of the previous plus debug output, only valid on Windows 11 or Server 2025 or newer. This log is managed by DISM itself, the values allowed may change with different versions of Windows.

options.name: log_path
options.description: Specifies the full path and file name to log to. If not specified the logging uses the default DISM log file location which is V(%WINDIR%\\Logs\\Dism\\dism.log).

options.name: name
options.description: A list of capability names to add or remove. Supports wildcard patterns like V(?) for single character matching and V(*) for multiple character matching.

options.name: source
options.description: Use the specified locations as capability sources.

options.name: state
options.description: Whether the capability should be present or absent. If V(present), the capability will be added if it is not already present. If V(absent), the capability will be removed if it is present.
